subject: Copywriting
title: Testimonials That Convert
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Testimonials That Convert.

hook.text: 'This changed my life!' means nothing. 'I lost 23 lbs in 8 weeks and fit in my wedding dress' means everything.

buildup.text: Effective testimonials are specific, named, and relatable. A real photo with a real name beats anonymous praise.

discovery.text: Testimonials from similar people sell best. A college student trusts another student more than a CEO.

twist.text: Video testimonials convert 25% better than text. Seeing a real face creates empathy that words alone can't.

climax.text: The best testimonials tell a mini-story: before, struggle, discovery, result. They mirror the sales narrative.

punchline.text: Specific stories from real people. That's a testimonial.

quiz.question: What makes a testimonial most effective?
